mcpSpawnSessionScope: <0>spawn_session_kandev</0> and tasks you create yourself are not affected. Workflow-selected profiles win first. Otherwise an explicit profile wins; Workspace default skips session and task profiles. External calls have no creating session and use the parent-task fallback for current_task.
mcpTaskProfileCurrentTaskDescription: For a live task-mode call, the new task uses the verified creating session's profile and its effective model, mode, and dynamic options, including changes made during the session. A workflow launch profile wins first. Without one, this follows the creating session; without verified session context, it falls back to the source or parent task profile, then workflow and workspace defaults. This can reuse a higher-cost setup.
mcpTaskProfileWorkspaceDefaultDescriptio: The new task skips the creating session and source or parent task profiles. It uses the workflow launch profile first, then the target workspace default. It does not copy the creating session's model, mode, or dynamic options. Choose this for a consistent cost policy. If neither workflow nor workspace supplies a profile, creation fails.
